name: u1
prompt:
Design the final pedal steel guitar plugin UI for Northern Valley Audio. Image 1 is Joshua's original favourite: match its TASTE (palette, serif wordmark, spaced small caps, black pill preset display, cream bakelite and black knurled knobs on a black inset panel with cream print, thin outlined value pills, hairline rules, calm cream space, soft warm light). Image 2: copy ONLY its A B C pedal blocks and LKL LKR knee-lever paddles exactly (their shape, rubber pads, amber lit A and B with LEDs above); ignore its knobs and colours. Image 3: the instrument's TRUE proportions and three-quarter 3D perspective (long, slim, legs, pedal rack, knee levers, contact shadow; keyhead LEFT, changer RIGHT). Rules:
# Taste extracted from Joshua's initial reference (#353), 2026-11-06

- Palette: warm parchment cream ground, dark walnut, black panels, cream bakelite. NO orange accents (Joshua: "i don't like the orange"). Amber only as tiny LED glints and the output meter.
- Type: classic dark serif wordmark "Pedal Steel" (not script, no speed stripes); NORTHERN VALLEY AUDIO in widely tracked small caps; labels in clean spaced caps sans; hairline rules.
- Preset display: a black rounded pill with crisp light text and small arrows (calm, not busy).
- Controls: black inset panel with cream print; mix of small cream bakelite knobs with printed tick scales, larger fluted cream knobs for the main pair, black knurled knobs; values in thin outlined pill boxes.
- Materials: instrument rich and polished (wood, chrome end caps); panels matte. Soft warm studio light, gentle shadows.
- Composition: calm, lots of cream space, thin top bar, thin bottom strip, instrument is the hero.
- Keep from later rounds: no PLAY/MOTION/EFFECTS tabs; controls on the outside, middle = the selected steel only, true proportions and 3D three-quarter view; better A/B/C pedals and knee levers; legible from across a room; preset switching restyles the steel.
- A/B/C and LKL/LKR (Joshua, 2026-11-06): use the pedal cluster from round7/p01_2.png — chunky dark rubber-padded pedal blocks for A B C (engaged ones lit amber with an LED above) and chrome knee-lever paddles for LKL LKR. Do NOT use p01_2's chrome dome knobs for VOICE/FEEL/SPACE; use #353's knobs.

Layout: thin TOP BAR (serif 'Pedal Steel' wordmark, NORTHERN VALLEY AUDIO, preset display '01 Sweet Georgia E9', arrows, BROWSE, SAVE, OUTPUT meter, TRIM 0.0 dB); MIDDLE = only the walnut steel as a 3D hero on a calm cream stage; BOTTOM = controls: VOICE (TONE 65 %, PICK 40 %), FEEL (GLIDE 145 ms, SWELL 35 %), SPACE (ECHO 18 %, REVERB 28 %) on a black inset panel with image 1's knobs; the image 2 pedal cluster A B C + LKL LKR; VOLUME PEDAL 72% slider; MODE Smart Auto-Pedal E9; MIDI LEARN. No orange, matte panels, uncluttered, legible from across a room. 1600x1000, ultra-realistic. Variation: knob panel on the left two-thirds of the bottom, pedal cluster on the right third, a thin cream strip underneath for MODE, VOLUME PEDAL and MIDI LEARN. Generate 2 images.
